6ad03e112524eff4be0f54b8e935d80ade8721ed.text:
**Long-term memory**

**People**
- Partner Sam: vegetarian; parents in Milwaukee (Christmas Day drive there). Training for half marathon until mid-Nov 2026.
- Daughter Maya: turns 7 on Mar 14 (~2019). Now soccer-obsessed, over dinosaurs/painting. Won't eat spicy — family meals need mild option.
- Mom: into gardening; birthday late June; always brings pumpkin pie for Thanksgiving — don't plan dessert.
- Dog Biscuit: needs sitter booked ≥2 weeks before any trip.

**Home / Work routine**
- Lives near Logan Square, Chicago (ORD). Does school drop-off every morning — no meetings before 10 AM.
- WFH Fridays — keep Fridays light on meetings.
- Runs 3 mornings/week; trained for May half marathon. Sat mornings reserved for family recipe website project.
- Health: lower back pain, has standing desk, avoid long drives / lots of sitting.
- Recurring: grocery order Sun 9 AM, store-brand by default (budget-conscious). Bills due 1st — remind 3 days before (~28th).

**Food / Drink**
- Usual cafe order: large iced matcha (switched Sep 2026, coffee made jittery).
- Likes Thai or Mexican takeout near home; Sam needs good veg options; always use recent reviews only — old ratings meaningless.
- Family dinners: mild + veg-friendly. TEMP until mid-Nov 2026: early carb-heavy weeknight dinners for Sam's training.

**Travel**
- Hates cold, prefers warm beach in Dec (Puerto Rico). Flights: direct only even if pricier, window seat — layovers wreck them.
- Lodging rule changed Jun 2026 after Michigan Airbnb cancelled night-before: hotels with free cancellation only, no more Airbnb.

**Preferences**
- Summaries as bullets only — only skims.
- Media: loves sci-fi + true crime, absolutely no horror.
- Shopping: buys refurbished electronics; prefers store-brand.

**Holidays**
- Thanksgiving: hosts ~8, order turkey by Nov 15 (sold out last year).
- Christmas: Eve at home, Day drive to Milwaukee — block Dec 25, check roads. Maya stocking gifts ~$50 total.
